skills.name: One with Fear (惧中人)
skills.line: Hey! Leave me alone to enjoy the humans' fear.
skills.description:
Those with fear have no where to run.
Amanozaku attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK. If an enemy has Fear, she commands them to use a normal attack on the same target (other than herself). ; Fear (恐惧) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Ineffective on monsters. Max of 8 stacks. When the inflicted target uses a normal attack on an ally, adds 2 stacks; when they use a normal attack on an enemy, lose 1 stack. At the start of the inflicted target's turn, they have a 15% base chance × the current number stacks of being inflicted with Silence, lasts for 1 turn.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 100% and the normal attack damage dealt by the commanded enemy with Fear is increased by 40%.

skills.name: Shadowdread (惧影随)
skills.line: Shh, your fear makes me powerful.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
You can never shake off your fear. Amanozako inflicts 4 stacks of Fear on a non-summoned enemy and increases her own move bar by 50%. She can inflict Fear on 1 enemy at a single time and she is immune to Fear.
; Fear (恐惧)

At the start of the inflicted target's turn, they have a 15% base chance × the current number stacks of being inflicted with Silence, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dread Blade Wind (惧刃之风/惧刃の風)
skills.line: Let the Dread Blade Wind rages on...
skills.description: Amanozako calls the Dread Storm, it has a 10% base chance of inflicting Silence on all enemies, lasts for 1 turn. Each Fear stack inflicted on the enemy increases the base chance by 3%. ; :

upgrades.text: Base chance increases to 15% and each Fear stack inflicted on the enemy increases the base chance by 5%.

skills.name: Spreading Fear (惧意蔓延)
skills.description:
Surrender to chaos in fear. Amanozako consumes 3 stacks of Fear to have a 60% base chance of inflicting Confuse on all enemies, lasts for 1 turn. Then issues a Call to Arms to all allies to attack the enemy with Fear.
If the enemy has less than 6 or more stacks of Fear, this skill changes to Dread Blade Wind.
